merge_rule: Raw ids share a PA canonical identity only when explicit provider metadata or a formal equivalence receipt proves equivalence. Names, descriptions, parameter similarity, pricing channel labels and adapter-family compatibility are insufficient.

evidence: Current Catalog contains tt-image-2 but no gpt-image-2.
v1/models reports tt-image-2 owned_by=lingkeai and exposes no alias/upstream/canonical field.
Skill guide documents compatible endpoints using tt-image-2 ids only.
A pricing channel group happens to contain gpt-image-2 in its label, but a mutable routing label is not an identity declaration.
Historical PA receipts remain bound to the exact raw id gpt-image-2.
The existing PA adapter-family mapping proves request compatibility only, not model equivalence.

gemini_legacy.reason: The legacy Gemini ids are absent from the current Catalog. Banana marketing names and compatible parameter shapes do not provide an explicit alias or upstream model id.

banana_aliases.reason: Token labels describe provider routing/billing variants, but no canonical upstream identity is exposed; reference limits or parameter signatures can also differ.

legacy_execution_exception.decision: May remain in existing legacy execution surfaces, but is not eligible for a Catalog-driven Composer until current availability or an explicit identity mapping is proven.

composer_decision.reason: No current Catalog canonical identity is stable in Overlay v1, and no legacy/current alias relation is verified.

boundaries: No Composer UI or routing policy changed.
No provider generation endpoint was called.
No ledger schema or historical record was modified.
